finding: A keyless MCP tools/call of resolve-library-id answers 200 with a real ranked result, and it silently spends the same anonymous allowance the REST API reports. Bracketed by keyless REST reads that each step ratelimit-remaining by one, the sequence gives twelve steps: seven REST-only ones (four across 76,75,74,73,72 and three across 64,63,62,61) every one exactly 1, three successful tools/call each exactly 2 (72-70, 70-68, 68-66), and two calls failing argument validation each exactly 1 (66-65, 65-64). The seven REST-only steps are the control: nothing else drew on the counter during the sequence. The MCP responses carry no ratelimit or quota header of any kind. An agent working only over MCP is therefore drawing down a monthly budget that its own surface never shows it, and no vendor page read on this date says the two surfaces share one counter.
